description: This file contains the implementation of the RoleWritePlatformService interface, managing role creation, updating, permission management, enabling/disabling, and deletion within the Fineract system. It interacts with repositories, handles data integrity issues, and includes annotations for transactional behavior and caching.

classes.name: RoleWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of role management service handling creation, update, permission assignment, disable, enable, and delete operations with transaction management and cache eviction.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Creates a new role after validating input JSON and handling potential data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Updates an existing role's details with validation and cache eviction.

methods.name: updateRolePermissions
methods.description: Updates permissions associated with a role based on JSON input.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role if it is not associated with users, otherwise throws an exception.

methods.name: disableRole
methods.description: Disables a role if it is not associated with users.

methods.name: findPermissionByCode
methods.description: Finds a permission object by its code from a collection of permissions.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity issues, throwing appropriate exceptions based on error messages.
